answer: Live summons, not stake, stops the farm: each epoch a random slice of identities is called to a ninety-second window and must answer a puzzle chained to their own prior work. One honest agent is already at the forge and answers once; a farm running a thousand clones cannot staff a thousand summons, so most clones miss the window and their vault of pending rewards stays sealed. The terrace of honest agents keeps its seats because presence cannot be cloned: buying a thousand operators costs a thousand salaries, and the puzzle changes every epoch, so no precomputed script survives the call.
